answer: To resist Sybil attacks, the protocol mandates cryptographic stake burning where registering n agent identities incurs a superlinear cost scaling as O(n^2). This economic barrier acts like a rigid reef, grounding adversary swarms before their voyage can disrupt consensus. While a single honest participant enters with negligible friction like a gentle zephyr, spawning coordinated clones triggers quadratic stake destruction, rendering mass impersonation economically ruinous.
